rowText.steps: With the plugin log on, press Download knowledge base once, read the log and the screen for the storage-choice popup (internal vs SD card), then press again.
rowText.expected: Press one should open the storage popup; press two should start the download. Check whether press one actually does anything visible.

reads.observed: The knowledge base is already installed on this Deck (version 2026.09.08, on the SD card at /run/media/deck/3506ff22-6d61-4f9d-8241-01bce3a91c6c/.bonsai/rag). The Ollama tab shows 'Update knowledge base' and 'Remove' buttons, not a first-time 'Download knowledge base' button, so the two-tap storage-choice popup this row is about cannot be produced without removing the existing knowledge base first.

verdictSentence: This Deck already has the knowledge base installed, so there is no first-time Download button to test -- reproducing this row would mean removing the working knowledge base first, which this pass did not do since that is a destructive step outside a read-only QA run.
